name: fongmi-desktop
description: A cross-platform desktop client compatible with FongMi and TVBox source configurations.
author: FongMi Desktop Contributors

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:desktop
scripts.package:mac:dir: npm run verify:electron && npm run assets:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config.electronVersion=43.2.0 --mac dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:dir:arm64: npm run verify:electron && npm run assets:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config.electronVersion=43.2.0 --mac dir --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run verify:electron && npm run assets:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config.electronVersion=43.2.0 --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run verify:electron && npm run assets:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config.electronVersion=43.2.0 --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:all: npm run verify:electron && npm run assets:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config.electronVersion=43.2.0 --mac dmg --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:win:dir: npm run verify:electron && npm run assets:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config.electronVersion=43.2.0 --win --dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run verify:electron && npm run assets:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config.electronVersion=43.2.0 --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:dir: npm run verify:electron && npm run assets:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config.electronVersion=43.2.0 --linux --dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run verify:electron && npm run assets:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config.electronVersion=43.2.0 --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:all: npm run package:mac && npm run package:win && npm run package:linux
scripts.release:formal: npm run release:preflight && npm run package:dmg:all && npm run release:verify:signed
scripts.release:formal:native: npm run release:preflight && npm run package:native && npm run release:verify:native:current
scripts.validate:native:libmpv: npm run typecheck && npm run audit:native:libmpv && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/native-libmpv-layout.test.ts tests/native-libmpv-preflight.test.ts && npm run build && npm run e2e:native:libmpv && npm test
scripts.validate:native:packaged: npm run package:native:dir && npm run e2e:native:packaged && npm run e2e:player && npm test
